feature: A long edit plays without the panel holding it up (pass 26)
summary: Playing the 6 minute edit with nothing picked no longer rebuilds the right-hand panel each time play crosses into a different kind of clip. The longest hold-up of the window in a minute of play went from 12 to 14 ms down to 6 to 7 ms, and the panel shows the clip you stopped on the moment play stops.
setup: Photonz Dev, release Next, no switch changed from its default. Measured on the probe with the speed walk (three runs each way) and the-panel-catches-up-when-play-stops-walk.

try.do: Open the 6 minute reference edit in Photonz Dev with the button below.
Click an empty spot in the timeline so nothing is picked, then drag the playhead to about 4:30.
Press Space and let it play into the B-roll on V2 that comes in at 4:31.
Press Space again about two seconds later.
Look at the panel's Time section: it should now be about the B-roll you stopped on.

evaluate: Does the panel staying on the first clip while the video plays past others ever get in your way?
When you stop, does the panel land on the clip under the playhead without a visible jump or delay?
Does a minute of play on the 6 minute edit look smooth to you, apart from the occasional single-frame stutter?
rough: While playing with nothing picked, the panel shows the clip that was under the playhead when play started, not the one passing by. I chose that over following because Premiere's Effect Controls never follows the playhead, and nobody tunes a clip that is sliding past; it catches up the moment play stops. No mock covers the panel during play.

0 to 3 frames a minute still go missing in play. Each one is the Mac's display refresh not reaching the window for 20 to 35 ms while the app sits idle, and a bare test window outside Photonz shows the same gaps. So nothing in the app is left to fix there; that is this task's own bar (a-long-edit-with-transitions-plays-scrubs-and-ed).

Edits with a clip picked still take 15 to 37 ms against the 16 ms bar (blade 24 to 26, a pick 27 to 35, unpick 29 to 37, a pick from nothing 31 to 42). That is this task's own bar (a-long-edit-with-transitions-plays-scrubs-and-ed), and this pass did not move it.
